title: Great Habit Tracker
body: Great, simple and free habit tracker! I love it!
author: Maxi020

title: Good app
body: I like the app and it really helps me with keeping track of my tasks and health, especially during exam season. But today it randomly switched to chinese and I wonder if there is a way to change that back? Otherwise no complaints.
author: Sydney93743

title: Clean. Simple. Ad-free.
body:
This is the perfect app. It's free, ad-free and clean. I love it and use it every day. 

If I could suggest one feature: Allow us to have different to-do lists. But it's amazing as is! Thank you, dev!
author: dseroair

title: Love the simplicity
body:
Great app that knows what it wants to do and does exactly that and nothing more. Tracking habits.

One quality of life improvement that would make me very happy would be if I could reorder my habits somehow.
author: VordenkerKeks

title: Wonderful!
body: Clean, easy to use, Beautiful! Dark mode would be nice 👍
author: Max Aisenbrey
